title: Archer
subtitle: Starry Form
description: Now and as a Bonus Action on later turns: a luminous arrow at one creature within 60 ft — +9 to hit, 2d8 + 5 Radiant.

title: Chalice
subtitle: Starry Form
description: When you cast a spell with a slot that restores HP, you or a creature within 30 ft can regain 2d8 + 5.

title: Dragon
subtitle: Starry Form
description: On Intelligence and Wisdom checks and Concentration saves, treat a d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10. Fly Speed 20 ft, and you can hover.

title: End Starry Form
description: Dismiss the starry form (no action required). The light goes out.
